tools.name: list_stores
tools.title: List Stores
tools.description: List all stores the user has access to

tools.name: get_order_stats
tools.title: Get Order Stats
tools.description: Get order statistics including counts by confirmation status (PENDING, CONFIRMED, CANCELLED) and shipping status (NOT_SHIPPED, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, etc.) with rates

tools.name: list_orders
tools.title: List Orders
tools.description: List orders with optional filtering by status, search term, and pagination

status.description: Shipping status filter. Valid values: NOT_SHIPPED, PROCESSING, SHIPPED, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, SCHEDULED, DELIVERED, RETURN_IN_PROGRESS, RETURNED, FAILED_DELIVERY

confirmationStatus.description: Confirmation status filter. Valid values: PENDING, CONFIRMED, CANCELLED, DUPLICATED, FAKE, RESCHEDULED

search.description: Search by order ID, customer name, or phone

tools.name: get_order_details
tools.title: Get Order Details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific order including customer, items, shipments, and call logs

tools.name: get_daily_revenue
tools.title: Get Daily Revenue
tools.description: Get daily revenue data for charting and trend analysis. Each entry has name (date), revenue, and orders count.

tools.name: get_order_status_distribution
tools.title: Get Order Status Distribution
tools.description: Get order counts grouped by status for pie/bar charts. Each entry has name, value (count), and color.

tools.name: get_confirmation_stats
tools.title: Get Confirmation Stats
tools.description: Get order confirmation statistics (pending, confirmed, cancelled, rescheduled, duplicated, fake counts, rates, call metrics)

tools.name: get_confirmation_queue
tools.title: Get Confirmation Queue
tools.description: Get the current queue of orders awaiting confirmation calls, with customer and item details

tools.name: get_agent_performance
tools.title: Get Agent Performance
tools.description: Get performance metrics for confirmation agents (calls made, confirmation rate, average call time)

tools.name: get_agent_leaderboard
tools.title: Get Agent Leaderboard
tools.description: Get ranked leaderboard of confirmation agents by performance

tools.name: get_hourly_stats
tools.title: Get Hourly Stats
tools.description: Get hourly breakdown of confirmation activity for spotting peak hours

tools.name: get_dashboard_kpis
tools.title: Get Dashboard KPIs
tools.description: Get key performance indicators: revenue, orders, confirmation/cancellation/delivery/return rates, average order value, active/new customers, revenue by day, orders by status, top products, low stock alerts, pending confirmations.

tools.name: get_revenue_analytics
tools.title: Get Revenue Analytics
tools.description: Get detailed revenue analytics with breakdowns by period (day/week/month)

tools.name: get_customer_analytics
tools.title: Get Customer Analytics
tools.description: Get customer analytics: new vs returning breakdown, top customers by spend, geographic distribution by city.

tools.name: get_delivery_performance
tools.title: Get Delivery Performance
tools.description: Get delivery performance by company: total orders, delivered, returned, pending, success rate, return rate, revenue, average delivery days.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.title: Get Inventory
tools.description: Get inventory list with stock levels, optionally filtered by low stock or search term

search.description: Search by product name or SKU

lowStock.description: Set to "true" to show only low stock items

tools.name: get_inventory_valuation
tools.title: Get Inventory Valuation
tools.description: Get total inventory valuation with per-product breakdown, lot details, and summary totals.

tools.name: get_customer_stats
tools.title: Get Customer Stats
tools.description: Get customer statistics: total, active, blocked (blacklisted), VIP counts, average lifetime value, and top customers.

tools.name: search_customers
tools.title: Search Customers
tools.description: Search and list customers with filtering options

search.description: Search by name, email, or phone

tools.name: list_products
tools.title: List Products
tools.description: Browse the product catalog with images. Returns product list with name, price, stock, status, and a thumbnail image for each product.

search.description: Search by product name or SKU

stockStatus.description: Filter by stock status (in_stock, low_stock, out_of_stock)

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.title: Get Product Details
tools.description: Get full product details with all images and variant information.

tools.name: get_product_stats
tools.title: Get Product Stats
tools.description: Get product catalog overview: total products, total variants, low/out of stock counts, total inventory value.

tools.name: get_top_products
tools.title: Get Top Products
tools.description: Get best-selling products ranked by revenue. Returns an array with id, name, sales, revenue, and quantity.

limit.description: Number of top products to return (default 10)

tools.name: get_product_analytics
tools.title: Get Product Performance Analytics
tools.description: Deep product performance analytics: top selling products and variants, size/color distribution, profit margins, confirmation/return rates, stock velocity, and upsell performance.

tools.name: get_product_drilldown
tools.title: Get Product Drilldown
tools.description: Deep analysis of a single product: per-variant sales breakdown, daily sales trend, top cities.

productId.description: Product ID to drill down into

tools.name: get_product_inventory
tools.title: Get Product Inventory
tools.description: Smart stock overview with inventory levels, min/max thresholds, warehouse info, and low stock flags.

lowStock.description: Set to "true" to show only low stock items

search.description: Search by product name or SKU

tools.name: list_delivery_companies
tools.title: List Delivery Companies
tools.description: Browse delivery partners with active status, provider type, and order counts.

includeOrderCount.description: Include order count per company ("true" or "false")

tools.name: get_delivery_company_stats
tools.title: Get Delivery Company Stats
tools.description: Overall delivery overview: total companies, active count, total orders handled, shipping revenue, and top companies.

tools.name: get_delivery_company_cities
tools.title: Get Delivery Company Cities
tools.description: City coverage and pricing for a delivery company. Returns an array of cities with name, price, and pickup (ramassage) availability.

tools.name: list_shipments
tools.title: List Shipments
tools.description: Browse shipments with status filter. Supports: PENDING, CREATED, PICKED_UP, IN_TRANSIT, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, FAILED_DELIVERY, RETURN_IN_PROGRESS, RETURNED, CANCELLED. Includes tracking number, recipient, delivery company, and tracking events.

status.description: Shipment status filter: PENDING, CREATED, PICKED_UP, IN_TRANSIT, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, FAILED_DELIVERY, RETURN_IN_PROGRESS, RETURNED, CANCELLED

search.description: Search by tracking number, order ID, or recipient

tools.name: get_shipment_stats
tools.title: Get Shipment Stats
tools.description: Shipment statistics: total, delivered/returned/failed counts, success/return rates, status distribution, and weekly performance trend.

tools.name: get_delivery_company_performance
tools.title: Get Delivery Company Performance
tools.description: Compare delivery company performance. Returns an array with per-company totals: shipments, delivered, returned, failed, success rate.

tools.name: get_shipment_tracking
tools.title: Get Shipment Tracking
tools.description: Live tracking for a shipment. Returns shipment details and real-time tracking info with events from the delivery provider.

tools.name: get_shipment_by_order
tools.title: Get Shipment by Order
tools.description: Get the shipment linked to a specific order. Returns full shipment with tracking events and delivery company.

tools.name: list_delivery_invoices
tools.title: List Delivery Invoices
tools.description: Browse delivery invoices with amounts, status (PENDING, VERIFIED, PAID, DISPUTED), and delivery company.

status.description: Invoice status filter: PENDING, VERIFIED, PAID, DISPUTED

tools.name: get_delivery_invoice_stats
tools.title: Get Delivery Invoice Stats
tools.description: Invoice summary: total invoices, total amount, and breakdowns by status (pending, paid, disputed).

tools.name: send_order_to_delivery
tools.title: Send Order to Delivery
tools.description: Send a confirmed order to the assigned delivery company. Creates a shipment with a tracking number.

orderId.description: Order ID to send to delivery

tools.name: bulk_send_to_delivery
tools.title: Bulk Send to Delivery
tools.description: Send multiple confirmed orders to delivery at once. Returns success/failed arrays with tracking numbers and error details.

orderIds.description: Array of order IDs to send to delivery

tools.name: get_shipping_label
tools.title: Get Shipping Label
tools.description: Get the shipping label URL for an order. The merchant can click the URL to print.

tools.name: bulk_get_shipping_labels
tools.title: Bulk Get Shipping Labels
tools.description: Get shipping label URLs for multiple orders at once. Returns label URLs per order and errors for failed ones.

orderIds.description: Array of order IDs to get labels for

tools.name: list_whatsapp_accounts
tools.title: List WhatsApp Accounts
tools.description: List connected WhatsApp Business accounts. Returns account name, phone number, status, and type (META_API or WEB_SESSION).

tools.name: list_whatsapp_templates
tools.title: List WhatsApp Templates
tools.description: List available WhatsApp message templates for a specific account. Returns template name, language, status (APPROVED/PENDING/REJECTED), category, and body text. The merchant should choose which template to send.

tools.name: get_no_answer_orders
tools.title: Get No-Answer Orders
tools.description: Get orders where customers did not answer confirmation calls. Filter by number of no-answer attempts (e.g. "2" for exactly 2, "3,4" for 3 or 4, "5+" for 5 or more). Useful for identifying customers to follow up via WhatsApp.

noAnswerCount.description: No-answer count filter. Examples: "2" (exactly 2), "2,3,4" (2 or 3 or 4), "5+" (5 or more)

whatsappContacted.description: Filter by WhatsApp contact status. "false" = not yet contacted via WhatsApp (default), "true" = already contacted

confirmationStatus.description: Confirmation status filter (default: PENDING). Values: PENDING, CONFIRMED, CANCELLED, RESCHEDULED, DUPLICATED, FAKE

tools.name: send_whatsapp_template
tools.title: Send WhatsApp Template
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp template message to a single customer. Requires an account ID, template name, and the customer phone number. Optionally link to an order.

accountId.description: WhatsApp account ID to send from

tools.name: bulk_send_whatsapp_template
tools.title: Bulk Send WhatsApp Template
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp template message to multiple customers by order IDs. The customer phone number is looked up from each order automatically. Returns success/failed arrays with summary counts.

accountId.description: WhatsApp account ID to send from

templateName.description: Template name to send (merchant must choose)

orderIds.description: Comma-separated order IDs to send to

tools.name: get_order_call_history
tools.title: Get Order Call History
tools.description: Get the call attempt history for a specific order. Shows each call attempt with outcome (NO_ANSWER, CONFIRMED, CANCELLED, BUSY, VOICEMAIL, etc.), duration, agent, and notes.
